about_the_game:
About

STATION is a (mostly) 2D psychological horror RPG-style game built with Raylib. You awoke on a derelict power station in the depths of space - you need to leave, but something's stopping you... for now, you only really need to keep the place going! Can't be too difficult, right...? But will you be able to leave it all behind one day, and finally escape from your literal and mental prison? That's up to you, I suppose.

Story

Wake up. Work. Sleep. Again. Again. And again. Again, again, and again. It's too tiring for you to change, for you to dig yourself out of this awful mess... the coffee doesn't even wake you up anymore.

There's always something more to do, something you could've done which you didn't, and you'll always beat yourself up over it (assuming someone doesn't do that for you). No matter how much you do, it's never enough - and the truth is that it never will be.

But maybe, just maybe, you can learn to let go, stop pushing, no, hurting yourself, and finally move on... Well, maybe.

Features (in final release)

  • Controller and Steam Deck compatibility

  • A limited but surprisingly detailed and ever-changing map

  • Some trippy 3D and non-euclidean sections

  • Countless unique tasks/minigames that push the boundaries of what is and should be possible to make in a 2D RPG

  • A dense ARG for you to uncover if you choose to delve into the game files

  • An emotionally rich story that will probably (hopefully) make you cry

  • (Simple) raytraced lighting (yes this is still a pixel art game don't worry)

content_descriptors.notes: The game will contain insinuated self-harm, depression and suicide. If you believe you may suffer from any of these, this game may not be for you.
